mods.name: No Limits
mods.description: Allows you to configure the max height of the world. NOT compatible with normal saves! Make backups!

releases.notes:
Beta 1.0.0 release of No Limits for Fabric 19w46b.

CAUTION!
 - this may lead to you losing any worlds you play with it
 - do not load any existing worlds without making a backup
 - do not load a No Limits world without the mod installed
 - future updates may break current No Limits worlds

readmeSummary: No Limits is a 1.15 Fabric mod that allows you to configure the max build height of the world. Erm.. I take that back; the current limit is currently hardcoded to 512. Config coming soon.
